package.description: Companion application for downloading barcode data from Opticon OPN-2001 series scanners

en-US.description: Companion application for downloading barcode data from Opticon OPN-2001 series scanners
en-US.longDescription: Retrieves scanned barcode data from Opticon barcode scanners running OPN-2001 mode or the OPN-2001 simulation application, including the OPN-2001, OPN-2006, OPN-2500, OPN-6000, and PX-20. Supports CMA/CMT docking stations (multicradles) and connecting multiple scanners to a PC directly, with manual and automatic operation modes. Features include viewing and updating device firmware, reading and synchronizing the device clock, viewing the device serial number, downloading, formatting, and deleting scanned barcodes, resetting devices to factory defaults, and adjusting operational settings such as symbologies, beeper, memory handling, and LED settings.
en-US.name: OPN Companion Application

zh-CN.description: Opticon OPN-2001 及兼容 OPN 系列条码扫描器的 PC 伴侣应用程序
zh-CN.longDescription: 从以 OPN-2001 模式或 OPN-2001 模拟应用程序运行的 Opticon 条码扫描器（包括 OPN-2001、OPN-2006、OPN-2500、OPN-6000 和 PX-20）中下载扫描的条码数据。支持 CMA/CMT 底座（多底座）以及将多台扫描器直接连接到 PC，提供手动和自动操作模式。功能包括查看和更新设备固件、读取和同步设备时钟、查看设备序列号、下载、格式化及删除扫描的条码、将设备恢复出厂设置，以及调整操作设置（如码制、蜂鸣器、内存处理和 LED 设置等）。
